description: A National Research Council committee secured a $25,000 General Education Board grant to develop intelligence tests for school children
title: A National Research Council committee secured a $25,000 General Education Board grant to develop intelligence tests for school children

description: The NRC committee trialed some twenty tests on five thousand children and produced two series of group intelligence tests of high reliability
title: The NRC committee trialed some twenty tests on five thousand children and produced two series of group intelligence tests of high reliability

description: The editor predicts NRC group tests will make intelligence testing a routine school measure and open the way for adjusting school work to pupil needs

description: A reliable positive relationship between parietal NRE and math achievement appears only in children, not adolescents or adults

description: Longer NREM periods in a short nap negatively correlate with subsequent encoding performance, possibly due to sleep inertia

description: Better NRMP rank correlates with higher milestone evaluations among otolaryngology residents at a single institution

description: NRMP rank shows no significant association with chief resident selection, teaching awards, or post-residency position

description: Final NRP test scores did not differ significantly between lecture-then-simulation and simulation-then-lecture training orders
